livrare.a: 5–14 business days in Romania, depending on the seller. Details are shown on the product page.

retur.a: Yes, within 14 days of delivery. Go to Your Account → Orders → pick the order and tap "Request return".

creator.q: How do I become a creator/seller?

plati.a: All payments go through Stripe (PCI-DSS Level 1). Swypik never stores your card details.

join.franchiseVertical: What do you want to operate

join.foundingDetail: 0% commission for the first 60 days, then 15% for life for the first 500 drivers. Next 2000: 18%. Standard: 20%.
join.goHeroSub: Earn from rides in your city with the lowest commission in Romania. No dispatcher, no monthly fees — just you, your car and the Swypik Go app.
join.goF1d: 0% commission for the first 60 days, then just 15% for life for the first 500 drivers. Uber and Bolt take up to 25%.
join.goF2d: Automatic payouts every week, straight to your account. See every ride and every penny in real time.
join.goF3d: Open the app when you want, close it when you want. Rides come to you — no bidding, no penalties.
join.foodHeroSub: Bike, scooter or car — pick your area, pick your hours. With Swypik Food you get orders from restaurants in your neighborhood plus volume bonuses.
join.foodF1d: Fair rate on every delivery, peak-hour and volume bonuses. Competitors cut rates — ours grow with seniority.
join.foodF2d: You choose the neighborhoods you deliver in. No forced 10 km trips, no penalties for declining.
join.foodF3d: Student, employed or full-time — deliver when you have time. Go online and get orders instantly.
join.frHeroSub: Become the exclusive Swypik partner in your city: recruit and manage local drivers and couriers and earn commission on every ride and delivery. Proven model, minimal investment.
join.frF1d: Commission on every Go ride and Food delivery in your city. As the fleet grows, you earn more — passively.
join.frF2d: One partner per city. First come, first served — big cities go fast.
join.frF3d: See your fleet, rides and earnings in real time. We bring the tech, payments and customers — you bring the people.
join.whyUs: Why Swypik and not the competition?
join.earningsTitleGo: How much you can earn as a driver
join.earningsTitleFood: How much you can earn as a courier
join.goS1d: Name, phone, city and the car you work with. No documents upfront — just contact details.
join.goS2t: We call you and verify documents
join.goS2d: Within 1-2 business days we contact you for licence, insurance and required permits (we guide you step by step if you don't have them all yet).
join.goS3d: After approval you get the driver panel: map, rides, real-time earnings. All from your phone, no dispatcher.
join.goS4d: Go online and receive rides in your area. Money accumulates in your wallet and is paid out automatically every week.
join.goE1: With 0% commission in the first 60 days, everything you collect stays with you. After the intro period, the first 500 drivers (Founding Drivers) pay just 15% for life — versus the 20-25% big platforms take.
join.goE2: An active driver in Bucharest averages 15-20 rides a day. At an average of 25 RON per ride that's 375-500 RON daily — with our 15% commission you keep 40-50 RON more per day than with competitors. Over 1,000 RON extra every month without changing how you work.
join.goE3: Referral bonuses: bring a fellow driver and get a bonus after their first 50 rides. Customers you bring with your personal code generate commission for you on every ride they take.
join.goQ1: Do I need an alternative transport authorization?
join.goA1: Yes, as on any ride-hailing platform in Romania. If you don't have it yet, we explain the exact steps and help with paperwork — most drivers get it in 2-3 weeks.
join.goQ2: Can I also work for Uber/Bolt?
join.goA2: Yes, no exclusivity. Many drivers run several apps and pick the best rides. With our lower commission, Swypik rides leave more in your pocket for the same distance.
join.goQ3: When and how do I get paid?
join.goA3: Automatically, every week, straight to your bank account. You see every ride, commission and bonus in the earnings panel in real time.
join.goA4: A car up to 15 years old with valid inspection and insurance. No new car or leasing through us required — work with what you have.
join.foodS1d: Name, phone, city and your vehicle: bike, scooter or car. The form takes 2 minutes.
join.foodS2d: We contact you within 1-2 days for a short check (ID; licence and insurance for motorized vehicles). No paid courses, no expensive mandatory gear.
join.foodS3d: Pick your neighborhoods and hours. The app shows restaurant, address and payout BEFORE you accept.
join.foodS4d: Every delivery has a transparent rate + peak-hour bonuses. Everything is paid out automatically weekly.
join.foodE1: Courier earnings depend on area and schedule: rates rise automatically at lunch and dinner peaks. An active scooter courier in a big city makes 80-120 RON in 4-5 peak hours.
join.foodE2: Unlike big platforms we don't cut rates as the fleet grows — the opposite: the more you deliver, the higher your bonus tier. Seniority matters.
join.foodE3: No penalties for declining: if an order isn't worth it, decline without hurting your rating. You decide what you deliver.
join.foodQ1: Can I deliver by bike only?
join.foodA1: Yes. In central areas the bike is often fastest. No licence or insurance needed — just ID and a phone.
join.foodA2: Usually 2-3 days from signup: one day for verification, then you get your account and can start immediately.
join.foodQ3: Do I need to buy a thermal bag or uniform?
join.foodA3: A thermal bag is required (use your own or buy one from us at cost). There is no mandatory uniform.
join.foodQ4: Can I combine it with university or another job?
join.foodA4: Yes — that's the point. No minimum schedule. Deliver 2 hours or 10, whenever you want.
join.frS1d: Tell us your company, city and what you want to operate: Go (drivers), Food (couriers) or both. We check territory availability.
join.frS2d: We agree the commercial model, your commission per ride/delivery and the launch plan. No hidden entry fee.
join.frS3t: Recruit your fleet with our help
join.frS3d: You get recruiting materials, city-dedicated landing pages and the management panel. Driver applications from your city come straight to you.
join.frS4d: We bring the app, payments, support and national marketing. You manage people locally and earn commission on every fleet transaction.
join.frE1: The model is simple: you receive a share of Swypik's commission on every Go ride and Food delivery made by your city's fleet. You sell nothing, hold no stock — you manage people.
join.frE2: In a city of 100,000, a fleet of 50 active drivers and couriers generates thousands of transactions monthly. Your income scales with the fleet — that's why we actively help you recruit.
join.frE3: The territory is exclusive: as long as you hit the agreed growth targets, no other partner can operate in your city.
join.frA1: Minimal: no franchise entry fee. You need a registered company, time for recruiting and ideally management or transport/delivery experience.
join.frA2: A share of the platform commission on each fleet transaction, set by contract per city and vertical. Paid monthly with a detailed report.
join.frQ3: What if my city is already taken?
join.frA3: We add you to the waiting list and suggest nearby free cities. Performing partners get priority for expansion.
join.frQ4: Who handles driver and customer support?
join.frA4: App and payment support is central, with us. You are the local contact for the fleet: recruiting, activation, day-to-day operations.
join.hostHeroSub: List your apartment, cabin, villa or guesthouse on Swypik Stays and get bookings at just 10% commission — half of Booking's. Money goes straight to your account, no subscriptions, no hidden fees.
join.hostF1d: Booking takes 15-20%, Airbnb 14-16% including guest fees. On Swypik you pay a single 10% commission only when you get bookings. Zero fixed costs.
join.hostF2d: Booking money goes straight to you, no 30-day waits. See every booking and every penny in your host panel.
join.hostF3d: We manually verify every listing: right of use, classification and tax compliance. Guests trust the platform, you get serious bookings.
join.hostS1d: Your details, legal form (individual, sole trader or company) and property details: type, address, rooms, capacity.
join.hostS2d: Within 1-3 business days we ask for the land registry extract (or lease/loan agreement), ID and the classification certificate where applicable. We guide you if something's missing.
join.hostS3d: After approval you get the host panel: photos, prices, availability calendar. Your listing appears in Swypik Stays alongside international hotels.
join.hostS4d: Guests book and pay online. You get an instant notification and money straight to your account. No extra fees, no surprises.
join.hostE1: With 10% commission versus 15-20% on Booking, an apartment rented 15 nights a month at 250 RON/night leaves you 190-375 RON more every month — money that goes to commissions elsewhere.
join.hostE2: Individuals can legally rent up to 5 rooms. For guesthouses and hotels we require the classification certificate — if you don't have it yet, we explain the Ministry of Tourism procedure.
join.hostE3: Your calendar stays yours: list on Booking and Airbnb at the same time, we don't require exclusivity. Many owners use Swypik for direct Romanian bookings where the low commission makes the difference.
join.hostQ1: Can I rent as an individual, without a company?
join.hostA1: Yes, up to 5 rooms, declaring income to the tax authority. Above 5 rooms or for guesthouses/hotels you need a registered business — we explain exactly what's needed.
join.hostA2: Land registry extract (or lease with subletting rights), ID, and for guesthouses/hotels the classification certificate. Easy upload after applying.
join.hostA3: You, 100%. Nightly price, long-stay discounts, cleaning fee — all under your control, editable anytime.
join.hostA4: You choose the cancellation policy at publication (flexible, moderate or strict). For out-of-policy cancellations, the money stays with you.
join.hostFormSub: Fill in your property details and our team verifies and contacts you within 1-3 days.
join.sellerHero2: Your products in front of thousands.
join.sellerHeroSub: Turn your stock into fast sales. Join the Swypik network for instant access to a huge audience with no marketing effort on your side. And if you have an ERP, products publish automatically.
join.sellerF1d: Your products appear in the Swypik social feed, promoted directly to an active audience that discovers and buys through video and offers.
join.sellerF2d: Everything is automated: you take the order, ship the package, we do the rest — payments, invoicing, notifications. With Multi-ERP connected, stock and prices sync themselves.
join.sellerF3d: Full transparency on commissions and transaction volumes. No listing fee, no monthly subscription — you pay only when you sell.
join.sellerS1d: Name, tax ID, contact and what products you sell. Takes 2 minutes, no documents upfront.
join.sellerS2t: We contact you and activate the account
join.sellerS2d: We verify the company and activate your seller profile with the blue verified badge, visible on every product.
join.sellerS3d: Manually from the seller panel, or automatically from your ERP: connect Multi-ERP with an API key and every product published from the ERP appears instantly on Swypik.
join.sellerS4d: Orders arrive in your panel (and ERP if connected). You ship, money settles automatically to your account.
join.sellerE1: Classic marketplaces take 15-25% commission plus listing or subscription fees. On Swypik you pay nothing until you sell, and the commission is transparent, shown before every listing.
join.sellerE2: The real difference is the social feed: your products don't sit in a catalog waiting to be searched — they appear in users' daily feed with big photos, likes and shares. A good product spreads itself.
join.sellerE3: Companies with Multi-ERP get an extra edge: the catalog publishes and updates automatically, orders flow into the ERP, and the profile gets the blue verified badge from day one.
join.sellerQ1: How much does selling on Swypik cost?
join.sellerA1: Zero fixed costs: no signup fee, no subscription, no listing fee. Just a transparent commission on each completed sale.
join.sellerQ2: Do I need an ERP to sell?
join.sellerA2: No. You can publish manually from the seller panel. ERP is optional — but if you have one (or want Multi-ERP), automatic sync saves hours weekly.
join.sellerA3: You ship with your preferred courier. We give you the order data, notify the customer and handle payment and returns per your policy.
join.sellerA4: Automatic settlement to your bank account with a detailed per-order report: price, commission, net. All visible in real time.
join.sellerFormSub: Fill in your company details and our team will contact you.
